column1: # Same shape as partitions_ota.csv — two OTA slots
# app slot (the t2can image is ~1.6MB) and ~9.9MB of littlefs for the flash log
# (its fixed 2MB) and the CAN captures in /cap (the rest).
# CHANGING THIS TABLE NEEDS ONE USB FLASH. OTA writes an app slot and nothing
# else; it cannot move a partition. Flash over the Type-C once (hold BOOT if it
# will not enter download mode): `pio run -e t2can -t upload`. On that first
# boot littlefs sits somewhere new and cannot mount
# the size it last mounted change (NVS sys/logfsSize) and FORMATS it once: the
# old /log files are lost. Download them first (/api/logs/file?n=..) if they
# matter. Every later boot keeps a failed mount unformatted
# Name      Type  SubType  Offset    Size      Flags
